[[Badlands]] (Formerly) |sandbox = Yes |rewards_increase = None }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Yeehaw!|In-Game Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Cowboy''' is a cosmetic [[Modifiers|modifier]] that adds cowboy hats onto most enemies. '''Cowboy''' appears exclusively in [[Badlands II]]; it is active in all matches on that map. It was also active in [[Badlands]], a now removed map. However, on the 23rd of July, it is active on all maps to celebrate the National Day of the Cowboy. It was first enabled on all maps on the 23rd of July 2022. ==Effects== When active, '''Cowboy''' modifier will add cowboy hats onto every enemy, with the exception of these enemies: *[[Husk]] *[[Undead Miner]] *[[Cavalry]] *[[Gunslinger]] On some enemies like the [[Normal]], the cowboy hat may be much bigger than it should be. When enabled on all maps on the 23rd of July, it will override the following cosmetic modifiers: *[[Space Suit]] *[[Scuba Gear]] (Does not remove the death effect) ===Enemy Appearance=== ''This does not include every enemy in the game, but only some to show the effects of the modifier.'' NormalCowboyMod.png|[[Normal]] affected by the '''Cowboy''' modifier. AbnormalCowboyMod.png|[[Abnormal]] affected by the '''Cowboy''' modifier. GiantSkeletonCowboyMod.png|[[Giant Skeleton]] affected by the '''Cowboy''' modifier. MoltenHoundCowboyMod.png|[[Molten Hound]] affected by the '''Cowboy''' modifier. SnowGolemCowboyMod.png|[[Snow Golem]] affected by the '''Cowboy''' modifier. FrostSpiritCowboyMod.png|[[Frost Spirit]] affected by the '''Cowboy''' modifier. ==Trivia== *Despite the National Day of the Cowboy changing from year to year (as it is the fourth Saturday of July), because the day fell on the 23rd of July in 2022, the '''Cowboy''' modifier is always enabled on the 23rd of July. ==Update History== *'''4 July 2022''' - [[v1.2.5]] **'''Cowboy''' added. *'''30 September 2022''' - [[v1.4.0]] **'''Cowboy''' is now active in [[Badlands II]]. **'''Cowboy''' is no longer active in [[Badlands]], as it has been removed. {{ModifierNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Cowboy}}
